newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon Byblos bank mid-year profits up 41.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon Byblos bank mid-year profits up 41.2 pct.

text.p: Lebanon's Byblos Bank net profits rose 41.2 percent to 23.015 billion Lebanese pounds ($15 million) in the first half of 1997, according to unaudited results issued by the bank on Tuesday.
This compared with net profits of 16.293 billion pounds for the first half of 1996 and 8.5 billion pounds for the same period a year earlier. ($ = 1535 Lebanese Pounds)
"Byblos performance was maintained at relatively good levels," the bank's senior financial analyst Allen Wanna said in a statement issued with the results.

Total assets at mid-1997 were 37 percent up on a year-to-year basis to 2,562 billion pounds and customer deposits rose 33.6 percent to 2,115 billion pounds over the same period, according to the results.
